'''Pyramimonadales''' are an [[order (biology)|order]] of [[green algae]] in the [[Chlorophyta]],<ref>See the [[National Center for Biotechnology Information|NCBI]] [https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/Taxonomy/Browser/wwwtax.cgi?mode=Info&id=38834 webpage on Pyramimonadales].  Data extracted from the {{cite web | url=https://ftp.ncbi.nih.gov/pub/taxonomy/ | title=NCBI taxonomy resources | publisher=[[National Center for Biotechnology Information]] | access-date=2007-03-19}}</ref> the only order in the class '''Pyramimonadophyceae'''.<ref>{{AlgaeBase taxon|name=Pyramimonadophyceae|id=126460}}</ref> The chloroplasts of phototrophic [[euglenids]] probably came from endosymbiosis with a member of this order.<ref>{{cite book| pmid=28429314 | doi=10.1007/978-3-319-54910-1_1 | volume=979 | chapter=Evolutionary Origin of Euglena | year=2017 | series=Adv Exp Med Biol | pages=3–17 | last1 = Zakryś | first1 = B | last2 = Milanowski | first2 = R | last3 = Karnkowska | first3 = A | title=Euglena: Biochemistry, Cell and Molecular Biology | isbn=978-3-319-54908-8 }}</ref>
